product.name: Clementine UVVIS 750 nm Global Mosaic 118 m v2.1 (USGS Astrogeology)
product.label: https://planetarymaps.usgs.gov/mosaic/Lunar_Clementine_UVVIS_750nm_Global_Mosaic_118m_v2_pds3.lbl
product.chosen: owner, 2026-09-24, over LRO WAC morphology mosaic (baked shading)

conventions.latitude: planetocentric (identical to planetographic on a sphere)
conventions.longitude: east-positive; column 0 = -180 deg, last column ends at +180 deg
conventions.bodyFixedFrame: MOON_ME (LRO-era mean Earth/polar axis); see ephemeris.json
conventions.values: relative albedo 1-255, linear in source pixel value; no reflectance scale in the label
conventions.gaps: albedo-mask.png is authoritative: white = never imaged. Albedo values there are compression filler

formatChoice.rule: smallest albedo with albedo + mask <= 6291456 bytes and PSNR >= 40.0 dB over imaged pixels

calibration.source: NASA Moon Fact Sheet, 'Visual geometric albedo 0.12' (https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/factsheet/moonfact.html)
calibration.model: Lommel-Seeliger, I/F = (w/4) mu0/(mu0+mu), w = albedoScale * texture value in [0, 1]
calibration.method: zero-phase disc mean of I/F equals the geometric albedo: albedoScale = 8p / mean(v), v weighted by projected area over the hemisphere facing longitude 0, latitude 0, gaps excluded
